plugin.name: Tony Hawk Pro Skater 2 Widescreen Fix
MAIN.ResX.description: Render width in pixels. If either dimension is 0, use the desktop resolution. Restart required.
MAIN.ResY.description: Render height in pixels. If either dimension is 0, use the desktop resolution. Restart required.
MAIN.FixHUD.description: Center and scale the HUD and menu elements for widescreen. Restart required.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Select the fix menu language. Auto uses English. Reopen Plugins to apply.
menu.title: Advanced Options
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
SkipIntro.description: Skip publisher, studio and opening skating movies. Movies selected from menus or played during gameplay remain available. Takes effect when the game starts.
MAIN.FOVFactor.description: Gameplay field-of-view multiplier on top of widescreen correction. 1.0 preserves the intended framing. Applies to normal follow cameras; replays, demos and scripted camera or zoom modes are excluded.
MAIN.WindowMode.description: 0: exclusive fullscreen; 1: framed window; 2: borderless at the desktop resolution. Requires restarting the game.
MAIN.FMVWidescreenMode.description: Fullscreen videos: 0 preserves the original aspect with black bars; 1 fills the screen with the correct aspect and crops overflow; 2 stretches to the screen. Applies live to the native fullscreen movie renderer. Menu preview videos keep their own layout.
MAIN.HudAspectRatioConstraint.descriptio: Single-player score/special and stance indicators follow their native screen side; the goal list stays right. Auto uses the screen width. A W:H ratio or decimal limits these groups to a centered box, clamped to 4:3–32:9. Timer, balance and trick text stay centered. Multiplayer placement is unchanged.
MAIN_ConfineCursor.description: Keep the cursor inside the active game window. Released while unfocused, dragging or using system menus. Turning this off releases it immediately.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Restore this plugin's settings to their shipped defaults. Press again to confirm.
menu.presethelp: Choose a preset, then press twice to apply it to this plugin.
